title: Trustworthy AI and Democracy: A Dual Taxonomy and Operational Framework of Democratic Risks and Contributions
abstract: arXiv:2505.13565v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) can undermine and strengthen democratic governance. This paper introduces the AIRD/AIPD framework, a dual taxonomy and operational framework for analyzing AI's democratic risks and conditional contributions. The AI Risks to Democracy (AIRD) taxonomy identifies threats to autonomy, fairness, public discourse, democratic institutions, and trust, while the AI's Positive Contributions to Democracy (AIPD) taxonomy captures AI's potential to enhance efficiency, accessibility, security, informed citizenry, transparency and accountability, inclusive democratic dialogue, and evidence-based policymaking. Grounded in five democratic principles and the seven Trustworthy AI requirements proposed by the European Commission's High-Level Expert Group on AI, the framework connects democratic goals with governance and design mechanisms. It provides an operational process for identifying affected contexts and actors,

translated_title: 可信人工智能与民主：民主风险与贡献的双重分类法与操作框架
translated_abstract: 人工智能（AI）既可以削弱民主治理，也可以强化民主治理。本文提出了AIRD/AIPD框架，这是一个用于分析AI对民主的风险及有条件贡献的双重分类法与操作框架。AI对民主的风险（AIRD）分类法识别了对自主性、公平性、公共话语、民主制度和信任的威胁，而AI对民主的积极贡献（AIPD）分类法则捕捉了AI在提升效率、可及性、安全性、公民知情、透明度与问责制、包容性民主对话以及循证决策方面的潜力。该框架以五项民主原则和欧盟委员会人工智能高级别专家组提出的七项可信AI要求为基础，将民主目标与治理及设计机制相连接，并提供了识别受影响情境与相关参与者的操作流程。
tldr: 本文提出AIRD/AIPD双重分类与操作框架，基于五项民主原则和七项可信AI要求，系统分析人工智能对民主治理的风险与积极贡献，并提供了识别受影响情境和参与者的操作流程。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the AIRD/AIPD, a dual taxonomy and operational framework grounded in five democratic principles and seven Trustworthy AI requirements, to systematically analyze AI's democratic risks and conditional contributions to democratic governance.
